references.text: The Lord promises that Israel will flee before their enemies if they are disobedient to the covenant, which is directly fulfilled in Joshua's lament
Warning that Israel will flee when no one pursues them, as a consequence of disobedience to God
God's explanation for why Israel had to turn their backs on the enemy - because of sin in the camp
A similar situation in the time of Judges where Israel could not stand against the enemies due to disobedience
The psalmist laments that God has let the people flee before the enemy and become plunder
Moses uses similar language in his lament to God: 'Lord, why have you dealt ill with this people?'
Moses argues with God about what the enemies will say if Israel is destroyed
